subject.title: ci(mantis): add web UI chat proof lane

question: Is hosted proof-shim run 28804452130 sufficient to accept the new Mantis web UI chat workflow before the literal workflow file is default-registered on main?
rationale: The PR adds a maintainer command path plus Mantis App/R2 publishing credentials; source review and hosted artifacts cover the behavior, but only maintainer intent can accept the remaining workflow-registration boundary.

options.title: Accept hosted proof and land
options.body: Treat run 28804452130 as sufficient coverage for authorization, candidate validation, Control UI proof, artifact upload, and Mantis App/R2 publishing.

options.title: Require another proof run
options.body: Ask for an additional maintainer-owned proof path if the shim run is not enough confidence before the new workflow is registered on main.

options.title: Pause the lane
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers do not want OpenClaw core to own another Mantis proof workflow yet.

recommendation.title: Accept hosted proof and land
recommendation.body: Treat run 28804452130 as sufficient coverage for authorization, candidate validation, Control UI proof, artifact upload, and Mantis App/R2 publishing.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the reusable Mantis evidence publisher and adjacent Control UI workflow surface.
